intent: Fix the companion-mode reliability defects from issue #50 (minih v0.2.1): orchestrator blind to a live run during its active window (A/B/C), local-time run IDs mislabeled Z (D), child MINIH_PROJECT_ROOT points at the run dir (E), inside-lane findings invisible to the documented operator read-path (F), clean runs misclassified as failed/degraded (G).
